trial_court: Court of Civil Judge (Senior Division) at Chikkodi in M.C. No. 61 of 1993
case_name: Mahadev Jyoti Umrani vs Smt. Sumitra
facts_of_case: The husband presented a petition under Section 13(1), (1-a) and (1-b) of the Hindu Marriage Act seeking a decree of divorce, but it was dismissed by the trial court. The husband then filed an appeal before the Court of Principal District Judge at Belgaum, which was held not maintainable.

legal_principles.principle: The forum of appeal from a decree passed by a Court of Civil Judge (Senior Division) is determined by the amount or value of subject-matter of the original suit or proceeding.
legal_principles.held: So, it is the amount or value of subject-matter of the original suit or proceeding, which determines the forum of appeal.

legal_principles.principle: When the subject-matter of proceedings is valued, the test prescribed under Section 19(1) of the Civil Courts Act cannot be applied to such a case.
legal_principles.held: the test prescribed under Section 19(1) of the Civil Courts Act cannot be applied to such a case
cited_cases: R.P. Muniswamappa v. Eramma, (1967) 2 Mys. L.J. 44

outcome.final_order: The final court order is that the appeal lies to the Court to which appeals ordinarily lie from the decisions of the Court given in the exercise of its original civil jurisdiction.
